brief: The 5 side hustles printing money in 2026 — fun edition.

slots.title: Side hustle gold
slots.ctaText: Five fun ways to get paid

slots.title: The New Playground
slots.body: AI did not kill side hustles. It just made them weirder, so the winners are selling vibes first and value second. Nostalgia is basically currency now.

slots.title: AI Roast Shows
slots.body: Charge strangers five bucks to watch an AI brutally roast their dating profile or resume. Host it live on TikTok for tips and reposts.

slots.title: Y2K Tech Flipper
slots.body: Digicams and flip phones are Gen Z's new flex. Buy them cheap at thrift stores, clean the lens, and resell with a moody photo set.

slots.title: Vibe Curator
slots.body: People will pay you to design their Spotify room, desktop wallpaper, and coffee corner. Package it as a full aesthetic takeover.

slots.title: Voice Clone Greetings
slots.body: Use ethical AI voice tools to create silly birthday roasts or hype intros. Sell them on Fiverr to gamers and small business owners.

slots.title: AR Thrift Stylist
slots.body: Film yourself styling thrift finds with AR filters that show fit variations. Link the items and take a cut through affiliate programs.

slots.headline: Pick One This Week
slots.body: Which hustle matches your vibe? Save this post and start tonight.
